rdf:Description.dcterms:title: System Package Data Exchange (SPDX) Ontology

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Provides a NamespaceMap of prefixes and associated namespace partial URIs applicable to an SpdxDocument and independent of any specific serialization format or instance.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/isoAutomationLevel](../../Core/Properties/isoAutomationLevel.md) instead.
Indicates whether the system can perform a decision or action without human involvement or guidance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 9.0 - 10.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDynamicLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element dynamically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Provides information about the primary purpose of an Element.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset may be distributed freely, without restriction.
These categories help define sets Responsibility Type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serious
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The highest level of risk posed by an AI system.
Information about different steps of the training process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: in use
Verification postcondition that are true immediately after a verification method has been performed
Specifies whether an additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/UseProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other specialized or custom verification method that fits the context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotInExecutePath
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The affected code is not reachable through the execution of the code, including non-anticipated states of the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The third-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeclaredLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact was discovered to actually contain each `to` AnyLicenseInfo (for example, as detected by automated tooling).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and an email registration is required before accessing the dataset, although without an affirmative acceptance of terms.
A value used in a generic key-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Absolute URL that can be used to locate a resource, as defined in [RFC 7230](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7230/) Section 2.7.1 or Section 2.7.2.
Specifies whether the License is listed as free by the Free Software Foundation (FSF).
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: container
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a container image which can be used by a container runtime application.
A license that is not listed on the SPDX License List.
This is the agent that performed the act of destroying the item.
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
Enumeration of verification types.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.
A prescribed change to a product.
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who was previously managing goods, services, or assets.
The point in time when an element or an action starts, becomes applicable, or becomes valid.
The result of applying a hash algorithm to an Element.
Specifies the CVSS vector string for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Concise Software Identification (CoSWID) tag, as defined in [RFC 9393](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9393/) Section 2.3.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: no
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates absence of the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.
Provides information about the completeness of relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other relevant type of proof or documentation not covered above.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: modifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is modified by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Lite profile specification.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iscc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Content Code (ISCC)](https://iscc.io/) is a content-derived identifier standardized by [ISO 24138](https://www.iso.org/standard/77899.html) for identifying digital assets. ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.
Provide context for a relationship that occurs in the lifecycle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. It is composed of three data elements: the International Business Registration Number (IBRN), the legal name, and the date of origin formatted as eight numeric characters (YYYYMMDD). Each element is separated by a pipe character (`|`) (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657|Code Management Association|19990420`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: library
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software library.

referenceSpecification provides a reference to a DefinedType that defines the specific meaning, structure, and semantics of a Role. It connects the role to its authoritative source definition, ensuring consistent interpretation across different contexts.
A specification type defines the nature of a specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a packaged instance of the `from` Element (`from` packagedBy `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isbn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Book Number (ISBN)](https://www.isbn-international.org/content/isbn-users-manual/29) is a unique numeric identifier for monographic publications standardized by [ISO 2108](https://www.iso.org/standard/65483.html). It consists of either 10 digits (for assignments prior to January 1, 2007) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISBN is composed of five parts: a GS1 prefix, a registration group, a registrant, a publication element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9780198836063`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published list of releases for a package.
CreationAction represents an event of product creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory as defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md6
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [MD6 hash function](https://people.csail.mit.edu/rivest/pubs/RABCx08.pdf)
Process plans outline the stages of implementation or use related to a process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: All other simulation types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.
Requirements can be categorized into various types based on their focus, purpose, and scope.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.
Defines the end of a range.
Identifies all the text and metadata associated with a license in the license XML format.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition.
Describes one a profile which the creator of this ElementCollection intends to conform to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scrapingScript
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset provider is not making available the underlying data and the dataset shall be reassembled, typically using the provided script for scraping the data.
Product Part Number as defined by OEM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ancestorOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is an ancestor of each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssociatedVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` Vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conditionalAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 3 - Conditional automation. The system can propose strategies and then automatically execute the approved plan, with an external agent being ready to take over when necessary.
A characterization of some aspect of an Element that is associated with the Element in a generalized fashion.
Provides a reference number that can be used to understand how to parse and interpret an Element.
Information about the AI software, not including the model description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
Provides information about the primary purpose of the software artifact.
Enumeration of the different kinds of SPDX file.
Results of general safety risk assessment of the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityDisclosureReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Disclosure Report (VDR) which provides the software supplier's analysis and findings describing the impact (or lack of impact) that reported vulnerabilities have on packages or products in the supplier's SBOM as defined in [NIST SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/161/r1/final).
processReadiness describes the readiness of a process.
A group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 384, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.
A license that is listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseNotes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the release notes for a package.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/Artifact is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element expands out as an artifact described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Makes no assertion about the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: npm
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an npm package. The package locator format is defined in the [npm documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-json) and looks like `package@version`.
Provides information about the type of an SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clickthrough
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and can only be accessed after affirmatively accepting terms on a clickthrough webpage.
An assumptionUID is a unique identifier assigned to an Assumption item.
Specifies a country code of the location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion about the type of support is made. This is considered the default if no other support type is used.
Provides a CVSS version 4 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: requirementUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a requirements management or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a requirement item.
Reproduction is the biological process by which living organisms produce offspring.
A value used in a key-value pair with a generic key that refers to an Element
Unit in which energy is measured.
The version of the SPDX License List used in the license expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: structured
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is stored in tabular format or retrieved from a relational database.
A name used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.
Anonymization methods used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasInput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Build, DefinedProcess or Action element has each `to` Element as an input.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isil
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Identifier for Libraries and Related Organizations (ISIL)](https://slks.dk/english/work-areas/libraries-and-literature/library-standards/isil/) is a unique alphanumeric code for identifying libraries, archives, museums, and related organizations standardized by [ISO 15511](https://www.iso.org/standard/77849.html). It consists of a prefix—which may be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a non-country code assigned by the ISIL Registration Authority—followed by a unit identifier, totaling up to 16 characters (e.g., `FI-Sipoo-Sö` or `ZDB-1-SBD`). Valid symbols include any alphanumeric character, solidus (`/`), hyphen-minus (`-`), or colon.
The measure of length refers to the dimension of an object or space that describes how long it is, typically expressed in various units depending on the system of measurement being used.
A key used in a generic key-value pair.
A concrete subclass of Element used by Individuals in the Core profile.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.
The boundary parameters define the area or region needed to describe a boundary.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where all elements apply.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM provides an inventory of software that is present on a system. This may be an assembly of other SBOMs that combines analysis of configuration options, and examination of execution behavior in a (potentially simulated) deployment environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: email
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Email address, as defined in [RFC 3696](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3696/) Section 3.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the documentation for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: providesSupportFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent provides support for each `to` Artifact. The use of the `providesSupportFor` type is constrained to `SupportRelationship` classed relationships.
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM of intended, planned software project or product with included components (some of which may not yet exist) for a new software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).
The element that has it's responsibility changed.
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.
Provides a reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence with an upper level requirement. Typically done as peer review, offline review or review meeting.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/endTime](../../Core/Properties/endTime.md) instead.
Property that describes the time at which a build stops.
Specifies the time when a vulnerability was published.
The intendedUse property is designed to capture a summary of how or for what item or artifact is meant to be used for.
A string in the license expression format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasProvidedDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a dependency on each `to` Element, dependency is not in the distributed artifact, but assumed to be provided, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Provides an indication of where to retrieve an external Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsolete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: superseded or not valid at present

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: implementedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is implemented in the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: requirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides a requirement needed as input for another Element.
Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of SBOMs that tools may create.
A property name with an associated value.
The record of destruction is entered in this action.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: createdBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Action or DefinedProcess is createdBy `to` Agent(s).

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/intendedUse](../../Core/Properties/intendedUse.md) instead.
The intended use of a given dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: foundBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was originally discovered by the `to` Agent(s).
The Boundary Definition Process refers to the process class used to produce boundaries.
This is how the currentState of an affected Element is found.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/Action is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates elements as products where the impact of a vulnerability is being investigated.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibrn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Registration Number (IBRN)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a unique identifier for legal entities standardized by [ISO 8000-116](https://www.iso.org/standard/75117.html). It is composed of two parts: a jurisdiction prefix and a local authoritative legal entity identifier (ALEI), separated by a colon. The prefix contains an ISO 3166 country code, an optional subdivision code, and a register code (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/ElementCollection is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of a type, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tracedToDetail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: the `from` Requirement is refined and further elaborated by each `to` Requirement, which contains more detailed implementation information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packageUrl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Package-URL, as defined in the corresponding [Annex](../../../annexes/pkg-url-specification.md) of this document.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ark
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Archival Resource Key (ARK)](https://arks.org/about/), is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) suited to being a persistent identifier for information objects of any type, standardized by the [ARK Identifier Scheme](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kunze-ark/) Internet-Draft. It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).
Type of support that is associated with an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altDownloadLocation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative download location.
Authentication protocol used by a server.
roleQualification specifies the requirements, criteria, or conditions that must be met for an entity to be considered qualified to fulfill a particular role.
The CreateProcess refers to the abstract process class that can be used to represent the process of creation of a product.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRoleIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a role in the `to` Element. The use of the hasRoleIn is constrained to `RoleRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent is delegating an action to the Agent of the `to` Relationship (which shall be of type invokedBy), during a LifecycleScopeType (e.g. the `to` invokedBy Relationship is being done on behalf of `from`).
Date of product release.
The action of product use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hardware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Hardware profile specification.
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.
A specification type defines the nature of a specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: staticAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a static analysis report for a package.
QUDT unit is used for measurement criteria based on product type, region and use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. The system can perform actions for an approved task without requiring the agent's continuous direct control.
A License participating in a 'with addition' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTestCase
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test case for the `from` Element (`from` hasTestCase `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).
A prescribed change to a product's location.
An actual change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is no support for the artifact from the supplier, consumer assumes any support obligations.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: binaryArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasExample
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an example for the `from` Element (`from` hasExample `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplyChain
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SupplyChain profile specification.
Gives information about the circumstances or unifying properties that Elements of the bundle have been assembled under.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.
An out of specification action is defined in this class.
Energy quantity.

https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Hardware/Hardware is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Products or commodities produced as a bulk unit are called bulk products. Commodities are often sold in bulk.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
